texts.facts: The primary concern of the Tbz Traders vs The Food Safety And Standards Authority ... on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132019194/ 1 Petitioners in the present Petitions, for the present, appears to be release of the subject goods i.e. areca nuts, which the Petitioners claim to be non edible in nature. The Petitioners are also concerned about release of the vehicles in which the material was being transported.
